topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The doorbell. Again. Who could it be now? I slowly open the door, and there they are—flowers, vibrant and silent, a stark contrast to the dull grey of the hallway. No card, no note, just a bundle of stems and petals. I run my fingers over the edges of the vase, cold and unyielding. The silence in the room grows heavier, the air thick with unanswered questions. Who would send such a messageless message? Each petal seems to whisper, but the words are lost, floating away into the corners of the room. I place the vase on the table, the water already growing murky, and I can't shake the feeling that I've stepped into a puzzle without the last piece.
